title: Prop 15.137: c_j over Max+ G-orbits; hemisphere formula; p=5 two-type (3/13,10/13); Q_j(hs) Max+-free; residual OPEN
settlement_note: No soft-close. c_j=∑_t w_t Q_j(y_t) on Max+ G-orbits in H_+. p=5: exact c_j=(3/13)Q_j(hs)+(10/13)Q_j(y_*). Q_j(hs) Max+-free; non-hs types need Max+-free reps/character sums for general p. N_ED4_SUF OPEN. L OPEN.

equivariance.theorem: Q_j(g·y)=Q_j(y) for g∈G, y∈Max+ (v_j G-invariant ⇒ Q_j constant on Max+ G-orbits).

hemisphere.theorem: G fixes ∞ ⇒ preserves H_±={y_∞=±1}; c_j = average of Q_j on H_+; c_j = ∑_t w_t Q_j(y_t) over G-orbits in H_+.

census.theorem: Max+ G-orbit census: p=3 r=1; p=5 r=2 (weights 3/13,10/13); p=7 r=5 types in H_+.

p5_formula.note: Q_j(hs) Max+-free; Q_j(y_*) needs Max+-free construction of y_*

Qhs.theorem: Q_j(hs)=∑_S v_j(S) f_hs(S) is Max+-free: v_j from G-quotient of T at eigenvalue 4p (C only), f_hs from Paley F_p indicators (15.135).
Qhs.reason: r>1 for p≥5 (p=5 has other type weight 10/13)
Qhs.dead_if_only_Qhs: ∑ Q_j(hs)² ≫ room (p=5: ~443 vs 23.6) — same as G·hs proxy (15.135)

open.open: Max+-free classification of H_+ G-orbit types for general p, weights w_t, representatives y_t, and character sums Q_j(y_t); then ∑_j (∑_t w_t Q_j(y_t))² ≤ room for all primes p≥5.
